newsitem.title: USA: MFRI says suit against it without merit.
newsitem.headline: MFRI says suit against it without merit.

text.p: MFRI Inc said Thursday it believes a patent infringement suit filed against it by Asahi/America Inc is without merit.

"We believe the allegations are without merit and without basis in law or in fact," David Unger, chairman, said in a statement. "Although the piping system in question, our Double Quick product, comprises less than one percent of MFRI sales and does not have a material effect on revenues or profits of the company, we plan to vigorously defend ourselves against the suit."
On Wednesday, Asahi/America said it filed a patent infringement suit against MFRI, seeking both a temporary injunction and a permanent injuction, as well as past damages and attorney's fees.
